_doc: Source of family_stats.json. scripts/gen_stats.py reads each scanner's docs at its vendored commit and extracts every number through the quotes below: a quote is literal text (whitespace-insensitive) in which each {#} captures an integer; several {#} or a list of quotes are summed; FILE:: picks a doc other than FINDINGS.md; {"q":..., "value": N} asserts the quote is present and uses N (for numbers the doc spells out in words). If a doc changes so a quote no longer matches, gen_stats.py fails instead of drifting. Text fields are curated and not checked.
